_comment: The single recurring 'common human' presenter. Reused across EVERY scenario so the face/voice stay recognizable. Veo 3 drifts between clips, so keep this description verbatim and pin the same seed + reference image each run. If consistency isn't good enough at scale, this is the block to swap to a Higgsfield Soul ID.
description: A friendly, down-to-earth Australian tradie in their early 30s, short dark wavy hair, light stubble, wearing a navy work polo shirt. Standing on a residential job site near a fence line in natural daylight. They hold a smartphone up in one hand and talk to it casually — dictating a job to an app — glancing at the phone then back up as they speak. The phone is angled so its screen is turned AWAY from camera and never visible. Relaxed, conversational, like leaving a quick voice note.
voice: Warm, casual Australian accent, unhurried, conversational — not an announcer.
action: holding their phone up and speaking to it
negative: phone screen visible, any app or UI on the phone, screen glare, no on-screen text, no logos, no studio lighting, no exaggerated gestures, not a presenter podium, not corporate, not looking only at the camera.
